title: MuleKit: Domestic Mule Discovery Toolkit
summary: MuleKit is an AI-powered OSINT toolkit that aggregates public data sources (Reddit, news, Scamwatch, PhishTank) and uses a local SLM to detect money mule networks and financial fraud in Australia. Its requirements.txt merely notes that SDV is an optional dependency for synthetic data generation, with no actual import or call found in the code.
evidence: mule_discovery/requirements.txt: '# Note: Mockaroo, SDV are optional - use their Python clients if needed'
needs: No code call site for SDV; only a comment in requirements.txt mentions it as optional, so usage cannot be verified.
